item.title: Diamond in the Rough! On 18 acres in Ohio. $300,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Love the acreage and the outbuildings! The house was built in 1880. It is located on 18.74 acres in Kinsman, Ohio. The house features wood floors, built-ins, wainscoting, baseboards, picture rails and a covered side porch. There are multiple outbuildings on the property, including a large barn. Four bedrooms and two bathrooms. $300,000 Contact Stephen Yoder with Kaufman Realty and Auction: 330-312-6269 From the Zillow listing: This newly listed 18.74

item.title: Character! Circa 1915 in Oregon. $349,000
item.description: This house has nice character outside! The interior could use a bit, but it is a nice house! The home was built in 1915. It is located in Eugene, Oregon. The house features an enclosed front porch, wood floors, built-in bookshelves, nice fireplace, baseboards and an updated kitchen. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,166 square feet. $349,000 Contact Luke Puskedra with Triple Oaks Realty: 801-866-5636 From the Zillow listing: Charming craftsman located in the heart of Eugene. item.title: Deal of the Day! Over 5,000 sf in Pennsylvania. Has a guest apartment! $199,000
item.description: This deal of the day is a big house! There is a guest apartment over the garage! The house was built in 1910. It is located on .61 acre in Johnstown, Pennsylvania. The house features pretty stonework, front porch, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, built-in seating, large fireplaces, chair rails, wainscoting, leaded glass and an updated kitchen. There is a detached carriage house with a guest apartment above. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 5,116 square feet. $199,000 Contact Renee Lizamb

item.title: Pretty stonework! Circa 1936 in North Carolina. $350,000
item.description: This house has pretty stonework! Beautiful area of North Carolina. Within walking distance to Lake Osceola. The house was built in 1936. It is located on .52 acre in Hendersonville, North Carolina. The house features a large patio, big stone fireplace, knotty pine, wood floors, built-in corner cabinets, built-in window sea and baseboards. There is a detached garage on the property. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 946 square feet. $350,000 Contact Phillip Trees with George Real Estate Group: phill

item.title: Has a guesthouse! Over two acres in Virginia. $294,000
item.description: There is a guesthouse on this property! Love the big old trees! The house was built in 1889. It is located on 2.25 acres in Drakes Branch, Virginia. The house features double front doors, original wood floors, baseboards, built-in corner cabinet, crystal chandelier, spacious kitchen and original mantels. The guesthouse is roughly 400 square feet. There is a large back deck, carport and a spacious yard. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,850 square feet. $294,000 Contact Daniel Keeton with Kee

item.title: Beautiful fence! Pretty interior! One acre in South Carolina. $215,000
item.description: That sure is a beautiful fence! The interior is nice! The house was built in 1941.It is located on one acre in Bishopville, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards, crystal chandelier and chair rails. The property has pretty landscaping and a screened in gazebo. There is a detached storage shed on the property. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,158 square feet. $215,000 Contact the property owner: 208-241-6364 From the Zillow listing: Enjo

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! The Frayser Bauhaus, C. 1946. Almost two acres in Tennessee. $250,000
item.description: This looks like a house you would see in Miami, not Tennessee. This art deco home is known as the Frayser Bauhaus. It was built in 1946. It is located on 1.7 acres in Memphis,Tennessee. This house was last used as a private residence in 1958. This could definitely be a unique home! It has 3,055 square feet. $250,000 Contact Margaret E. Mikkelson with Marx Bensdorf Realtors: 901-682-1868 From the Zillow listing: A landmark could be yours. The Frayser Bauhaus is now available for purchase. DREAM I
